definitions.full: H6716. tsiy I. צִי noun masculine Isa 33:21 ship (loan-word from Egyptian t'a£ , according to Bondi 66 , compare Erman ZMG xivi (1892),123 DHM VOJ viii. 7, 165 ); — absolute אַדִּיר צִי 33:21 a majestic ship ; plural צִים Num 24:24 (JE), Ezek 30:9 ( ׳בַּצּ ; but ᵐ5 σπεύδοντες , compare ᵑ6 , whence Co Berthol אָצִים ). צִים צִיּים, see I, II. ׳צִ . צִין proper name, of a location see צִן צִינֹק see צנק . צִיעֹר see צער . ציף see II. צוּף . I. צִיצָה צִיץ v, I.[[ צוּץ ].
